summary: Verified schedule-CTA journey (Home/ClosedHero -> /menu?schedule=1 -> banner + intent -> checkout auto-delivery + highlighted required slot panel), backend closed-with-scheduled-slot bypass in _quote_or_create, tablet /api/tablet/customers/lookup auth+shape+found:false paths, and Rechercher UI fill+editable. Backend: 14/14 tests passed in /app/backend/tests/test_schedule_and_lookup.py plus prior 12/12 in test_new_features.py still valid. Frontend: schedule CTA present on Home (open state), routes to /menu?schedule=1, banner renders, sessionStorage bt_schedule_intent=1 set, mobile 390px shows NO horizontal overflow on the schedule menu path. Checkout with intent: fulfillment defaults to Livraison, delivery-schedule-panel is highlighted (animate-pulse border-2 border-[#FFB800]), submit disabled until slot chosen; slots endpoint returns 6 same-day windows starting 21:20. Tablet: temporary staff created, Rechercher fills first/last/phone/email (screenshot verified TESTMonaco / PrefixUser / +377 / testmonaco@...); manual edit after lookup works (fields remain editable). No orders were persisted; no kitchen accept/reprint/test-print calls. Tablet staff and any temp changes reverted.

issues: Panel uses animate-pulse indefinitely on the whole panel; while attention-grabbing, some users may find it distracting once they interact. Consider stopping the pulse once a slot is selected.
React hydration warning: <span> inside <option> (delivery-slot-select) — comes from the source-mapping instrumentation on 'label' JSX text. Cosmetic only in dev; won't ship in prod build.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py _quote_or_create closed-scheduled branch: correctly bypasses _ensure_accepting_orders when scheduled_slot is truthy, then still rejects force_closed with 423. Ordinary closed+no-slot still returns 423 via _ensure_accepting_orders. Verified end-to-end.

delivery_slots() returns [] both when day is not open AND when now is past close (last_end < now+lead+window). This inherently enforces 'booking allowed only before today's upcoming opening (not after close)'.

Tablet lookup response returns only the eight editable fields {first,last,phone,email,address1,address2,postal,city}. Never leaks _id, order_number, status, password_hash. Auth enforced via require_tablet.

Checkout canSubmit correctly gates on (!scheduleIntent || !!selectedDeliveryStart) — schedule journey cannot be submitted without a slot, while ordinary delivery still permits ASAP (empty slot = 'Dès que possible').
Mobile /menu?schedule=1 verified: body.scrollWidth == clientWidth (390px = 390px), no horizontal overflow.

Minor nit: delivery-schedule-panel wraps the entire Field including label in animate-pulse. Users with vestibular sensitivity may prefer respecting prefers-reduced-motion. Consider gating animate-pulse with motion-safe:. Non-blocking.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on all critical schedule + lookup flows
